Title: Mario Kart Tour: How To Collect 50 Coins In A Race
URL: https://xboxplay.games/mario-kart-tour/-how-to-collect-50-coins-in-a-race-4364
Published: 2019-11-06T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Mario Kart Tour coins
...
The challenge is quite simple to understand but not so much to complete. What you have to do is get 50 coins in the same race. In this challenge as complicated as it may be, the key is to choose the track and the right driver, and also to drive a little slower than normal, this is very important.
...
How to collect ... race in Mario Kart Tour
...
The 50cc race has been the one that has not offered the best results, so we recommend using it if you want to get there first and get all the coins at the same time, because the races are slower.

The track is something very important, you have to get at least 50 coins, so you have to choose one that has them all and more if possible. In this sense we will recommend Choco Island 2, where you can get up to 25 coins in each round. On this map the best pilot for this mission is Wendy, who with his Coin Frenzy will allow you to get coins much faster. You can try to match the course and the drivers to try to hit a Coin Frenzy in any race as many times as necessary until you get all the coins. Avoid being hit or you will drop coins, instead, hit the opponents to drop their coins and you can collect them. Now that you know how to collect 50 coins in a Mario Kart Tour race, things shouldn't be that complicated. We hope that our guide allows you to continue moving forward quickly with the weekly challenges, good luck.
